mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering earnings concerns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand weakness, causing negative equity sentiment and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust industrial production growth (INDPRO above 1.5% YoY) signals strong corporate output capacity, supporting earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during INDPRO > 1.5% YoY periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates sustained economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 is positive, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, triggering expectations of tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous slowing employment growth (PAYEMS decline) and restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signal dual economic stress, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates below 4.0% in late-cycle expansion regimes signal imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
